question: How does the requested six-query Transformer train and forecast on all eligible five-minute SPX windows?
comparison: Persistence on the identical six-horizon validation windows; prior rolling CNN at the common 20/30-minute endpoints is a package comparison only.
prediction_token: one trainable 128-dimensional vector, expanded to six positions
position_embedding: fixed sinusoidal encoding of UTC elapsed minutes / 5 from the forecast origin, shared between past and future
attention_mask: past queries see past keys; future queries see all past/future keys; future inputs contain no observed targets
readout: shared Linear(128, 1) on each of six future hidden states
loss: SmoothL1 averaged over all six targets after train-only per-horizon RMS scaling
input_scaling: train-only global RMS of relative log OHLC history
learning_rate: 50-update linear warmup to 0.0003; cosine decay to 0.00003 by update 1000
checkpoint_selection: lowest mean six-horizon validation MAE (bp), including update zero

batch_calibration.precision: BF16 autocast; FP32 parameters and AdamW states
batch_calibration.search: doubling followed by binary search at 256-window resolution, isolated processes; try activation checkpointing if needed
batch_calibration.headroom: larger of 4 GiB or 5 percent of actual device memory

diagnostics: every optimizer-step loss, gradient norm and LR; complete train/validation evaluation every 25 updates; optimizer state retained
interpretation: Exploratory validation; checkpoint selection is not adjusted by paired date-block intervals. Architecture, six-target objective, batch and optimizer settings change together. Completion of the bounded budget does not establish convergence.
